sql.country.getAll: select c.id, c.country, c.abbreviation from flow.country c order by c.country
sql.country.getAllForCompany: select cc.id, cc.company_id, cc.archived, cc.country_id, c.country, c.abbreviation from flow.company_country cc inner join flow.country c on c.id = cc.country_id where cc.archived is not true and cc.company_id = :companyId order by c.country
